title: Gray Event
text: “Repop… Does that mean you’re immortal!?”
“Not exactly, and I’m sure I have weaknesses, but it’s hard to take me down right away. Maybe it’s true that the Sword Hero is the one who created this troublesome situation!”
“No matter what, I’ll protect Black Thunder!”
“Huh… Did you really think Dr. Azot and his device wouldn’t figure out a way to deal with you?”
Rafumi stands there with a smug expression, looking down on me. Damn you, Ren! You’re putting up a futile fight.
“Ren-san from the future is really full of murderous intent, isn’t he? He’s coming at Black Thunder with everything he’s got to wipe him out.”
“Isn’t it because Itsuki was saved by Rafu-emon? It’s like, ‘Why just me…?’ and he fell into the darkness. I get the feeling there’s some jealousy mixed in too.”
“That’s definitely possible.”
Why are you talking like you’re just a bystander?!
“Well then… I guess it’s time to get this over with.”
As soon as Rafumi said that… swish, swish, swish… a massive chorus of footsteps echoed from all around us. Looking around, I saw… countless Rafumis charging toward us from the horizon.
“T-The Rafumi Army!? Just how many of them are there!?”
“Guess we’ve got no choice but to fight! Rapid Fire X! Rapid Rain X!”
Itsuki launched an attack against the countless Rafumis, as if providing covering fire. I joined in the attack as well.
“Aiming Lancer X! Brionac X! Gungnir X! Liberation Firestorm X! Liberation Prominence X! Liberation Fire Eye X! Windmill X!”
I unleashed these attacks against the countless Rafumis rushing toward Black Thunder from all directions.
“Well… since they look like oversized versions of Raph-chan, seeing them get blown away doesn’t exactly leave a good impression.”
“We can’t be saying things like that!”
“Let’s do this! Go—!”
“Everyone in the village! Protect yourselves!”

Thanks to Father’s warning, the villagers were also on high alert, preparing to defend against the Raufumis… but no, the Raufumis seem to have no hostility toward anyone but Black Thunder, so they just ignore us and charge right through.
“It’s useless… Spear Hero, you and the Filolials won’t be able to wipe me out.”
“Ugh…”
No matter how many you defeat, countless Rafumis keep appearing and charging straight at Black Thunder. Defeating them is a breeze, but there are just too many of them.
“There’s no end to this! Ren-san! Why are you just standing there watching?! This isn’t a joke anymore!”
“Ah, ah… Rafumi! Stop it!”
“I cannot obey that order. Just sit back and watch, Azot.”
“At least he’s consistent in making it seem like he’s doing this for Ren.”
“Ugh…”
“Air Strike Shield X! Second Shield X! Shield Prison X! T-there are too many of them! We’re in trouble if the effects wear off!”

Rafmi and the others are swarming around, trying to destroy the shields that the Father has deployed, but they can’t break them. Their Attack Power probably isn’t that high to begin with. In fact, since even an Aiming Lancer can take them down, it seems their individual abilities aren’t all that impressive. However, the Father’s shields also have a limited duration.
“Gyaaaaaaaaaaaah!”

Black Thunder bolts out the moment the shield’s cage vanishes, but the Rafumis swarm after him. However, Black Thunder’s escape route is all wrong! If he keeps going like that, the Rafumis will catch him!
“W-w-wait! Black Thunder’s been caught!”
“Wait a moment!”
“I won’t let you interfere.”

With a swish, the Rafumi cast Magic right at us. Guh… I see countless Rafumi who’ve caught Black Thunder, and I can’t tell which one is real. If we attack recklessly, we might even hit Black Thunder by mistake.
“What a troublesome situation this is! Rival! Do something about this illusion!”
“Even if I dispel them, they just keep reappearing! It’s sheer numbers! Even if I cast a Magic spell to grant immunity, it’ll take time…”
Rival is preparing a Magic spell, but he’s saying he won’t make it in time. He’s useless!
“Ha! That’s right! Cause and effect! Ren!”
I switched targets and fired a Paralyze Lance at Ren!
“I knew you’d do thataaaaaa! Haah!”
Ren deflected my lance and swung his sword at me.
“Tch! If I take Ren hostage right here, Black Thunder will surely be saved! After all, you’re the one who created him!”
“No way am I letting that happen!”
“Why are you fighting amongst yourselves, Motoyasu-kun!”
“You just attacked him naturally and without hesitation, didn’t you? I knew you’d do it someday. I knew that, deep down, Filolial took priority over us for you, Motoyasu-san.”
“We can’t turn on each other like this! Motoyasu-san!”
Fleon-chan called out to us, but there’s no way I’m backing down now.
“Gyaaaaaaa!?”
Countless Rafumi are pointing their blades at Black Thunder, as if he has nowhere to run.
“Don’t move, Spear Hero. Black Thunder will die the moment we make a move. Before you even think about attacking Azot.”
“Uuuugh…”
Faced with Black Thunder, who kept screaming with a look of sheer terror, I found myself unable to move. What a guy… What am I supposed to do?
“Stop forcing yourself on the Dark Holy Hero—he’s clearly had enough!”
“I-I won’t! So please, help me!”
“Is that true? If it’s a lie, I won’t show mercy… Don’t think the Spear Heroes will come to your rescue if anything happens, okay? This is the consequence, after all…”
One of the Rafumi swiftly pressed a blade against Black Thunder’s neck to threaten him.
“O-okay! I won’t do it anymore! So please, help me!”
“That’s final. Engrave it firmly in your heart, and never, ever forget it…”
“Um…”
Just as I was thinking about what to do next, my Father and Itsuki muttered to themselves.
“Well then… I guess that’s it.”
With that, the countless Rafumis vanished, merging into a single form, and moved away from Black Thunder toward us.
“Mission complete.”
“H-h-hii…”
Black Thunder is sitting there with the same expression Kou had that day.
“I do not take lives. I have come to eradicate that bloated desire for self-aggrandizement.”
“Ah, so you’ve come to cure Black Thunder’s middle-school-level delusions.”
“That’s a rather extreme method, Ren-san.”
“Y-yeah, I guess so…”
“Spear Hero… This is what you’ve brought upon yourself. Do you understand?”
“I don’t understand!”
This guy is the enemy!
“Cause and effect—if you hadn’t forced Black Thunder onto Azott, none of this would have happened. You went too far.”
Grrr… Just what kind of karma brought this guy here?! I didn’t see him in the loop where I was reunited with Fleon-chan.
“Well then… on to the next mission. Monitoring Black Thunder and guarding Azot… Let me share the words the Spear Hero is said to have spoken: ‘I’ve come from the future to protect you.’”
With that, Rafumi bowed to Ren. That’s… that’s a rip-off, isn’t it!?
“How should I put it… It looks like someone who’s a bit of a wild card in more ways than one has come from the future, Ren-san.”
“Ah… yeah. “But in terms of being a troublemaker, Motoyasu is cut from the same cloth.”
“…True. He did attack Ren-san without hesitation in that situation, after all.”
With an expression that seemed to say, “What should I do?”, Ren turned to his Father.
“Ren, order him to self-destruct!”
“I’m sorry, but absolute obedience to Azot’s orders isn’t my mission—there are some orders I simply cannot follow. I act according to my own judgment.”
The Big Sister from the first world once said that it’s a servant’s duty to correct their master if he’s wrong. Ugh… I’ll have to figure out how to deal with this guy.
“A troublesome one’s come along.”
“You’re the one saying that?”
“Um…”
Filoko-chan and Rafuemon each say their piece.
“I wonder how it works that, even though he’s a Rafumi, his role is that of an assassin from the future. And the fact that it’s a liquid lifeform, too.”
“Considering its connection to the Sword Hero, it’s obvious they’re using Chocolate Monsters as raw material.”
“Oh, I think they mentioned something about that. A seasonal monster that appears around Valentine’s Day, right?”
“Exactly. It caused a commotion in the first world—Wild Naofumi’s—but over here, it’s using the ‘immortality’ trait it possesses.”
“It’s not immortal. It’s just temporarily multiplied. That same trick won’t work on the heroes.”
Rafumi corrected her Rival’s statement. “In that case, let’s look for an opening and destroy them.” “No, they’ll just come back to life that way.” “How can we completely annihilate them, then!?”
“So, Rafumi-chan, is it safe to say your goals are to correct Black Thunder and escort Ren? The creator is Ren from the future.”
“That’s correct. The commands inscribed in the device that created me are as such. At the same time, they were imbued with Azot’s wish and her jealousy toward Black Thunder.”
“A wish and jealousy?”

“That’s right. It’s the wish of Azot—single and lonely—who longs for a modest happiness, thinking that if she hadn’t awakened, she might have had a different, better future. And it’s also filled with jealousy toward Black Thunder, who takes her out to enjoy various events like Christmas and Valentine’s Day.”
Rafumi spoke dismissively to the cowering Black Thunder, looking at him as if he were trash. Grrr!
“Whoa… Black Thunder, you actually do things like that?”
“Even though he brainwashed himself, he’s still going on dates with her—that’s what Azott realizes that day, snapping back to his senses and trembling in loneliness.”

HAHAHA, that’s the part where you’re supposed to laugh! But his Father and the others wore indescribable, troubled expressions. In short, it means that Ren’s future self is a total embarrassment. And apparently, once the event is over, he’ll reawaken and resume his activities alongside Black Thunder.
“That would certainly be frustrating. To have brainwashed her, only to see him happily enjoying their anniversary with his girlfriend… that’d make anyone want to kill him.”
“In short, it means ‘those with fulfilling real lives should die,’ right?”

“Ah… I heard that even the first Sword Hero of the World almost ended up single. I also heard that on Valentine’s Day, he wasn’t sure if he’d get anything from his older sister or Eclair, so he was reportedly glued to the mailbox.”
“Stop it! Don’t give me that pitying look! I’m not lonely at all!”
“You might not feel that way now, but eventually, you’ll probably end up feeling empty… Ren, I’ll make whatever you want to eat today, okay?　How about Golden Usapil stew?”
“Don’t try to sweet-talk me!”
“Really… I hope you find someone nice… Should I ask Wyndia-chan and Eclair?”
“S-t-o-p! And Motoyasu, for once, stop looking for an opening!”
Ren said this with particular intensity. Tsk… So he noticed.
“Motoyasu… I’ll have a word with you later.”
My Father gave me a warning with a smile—a smile that was both cheerful and chilling enough to make my spine freeze.
“But… this should change the future, right? What does it mean that Rafumi-san exists so calmly?”
“Ah, regarding this matter, Azot… there’s something Ren must do.”
“…What is it?”
“We’ll need you to build a device to create me—to make the future add up.”
“I see. If we build the device to create Rafumi-chan and set the objective, the result will be the same… It’s pretty far-fetched, but maybe we should just think of it as a preemptive promise.”
“Ugh… what a hassle.”
“It looks like you’ll end up living a lonely life if you don’t do it, so I guess you have no choice, right?”
“It’s kind of sad to be lonely, even though you’re studying blacksmithing.”
Both Father and Itsuki are constantly giving Ren sympathetic looks.
“Can’t the old man at the weapons shop or someone like that set you up with someone?”

“Maybe it was difficult because of your age? It’s more like you’ve gotten so caught up in this man’s world that you’ve missed your chance to get married. He valued friendship over romance… Doesn’t that sound like fun in its own way?”
“He really does need a girlfriend.”
“Shut up! We should just celebrate that a new future has opened up for me!”
“I wonder if it’s a bit odd for you to say that yourself… Well, I guess it’s fine.”
“Though he’ll end up with a weird golem in tow.”
“My goal is to see to it that Ren lives a healthy, long life.”
Rafumi… I’ll keep that in mind. You’re the enemy, after all! I’ll make sure to take every step necessary to ensure you’re never created!
“It looks like things have settled down for now, but as for Motoyasu-san, I’ll leave him to you, Naofumi-san.”
“Ah… I suppose so. Even though he brought this on himself, he seems to be holding a grudge, so I’ll have a word with Motoyasu-kun.”
Grrr…
“Anyway, I guess this wraps up the commotion… right? I sure hope so.”
“Naofumi, if that’s what you think, please refrain from making careless remarks. If you drop any new ‘material’ here, I have a feeling something else will pop up.”
“‘Material’… If there’s going to be a follow-up related to Rafuemon, it’d be about the six unique best friends who swore a passionate bond of friendship—”
“That’s exactly what I’m telling you to stop! Don’t say the rest!”
“Oops, well… that one was actually pretty popular, but it’s turned into a dark past now. Better not say it, huh?”
“Kyuu?”
“Um… Itsuki-kun, we… can stay here, right?”
Filoko-chan tilts her head, and Rafuemon tilts his head apologetically toward Itsuki, asking as if pleading.

“Honestly, I’d rather you didn’t, but it seems they don’t have anywhere else to live. I guess there’s no helping it. This is everyone’s village, so as long as you don’t cause any trouble, you’re welcome to stay.”
“Yeah! Nice to meet you all again! So, Itsuki-kun, I’ll show you all sorts of other tools, so look forward to it!”
“Filoko’s gonna show you the upgraded versions of those junk items, kyu.”
“What a great friendship! Justice-san.”
Fleon-chan is deeply moved by the friendship between Rafuemon and Itsuki.
